item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

answer_sheet.Exact on-screen copy:
Scene 1: Less scrolling. More doing.
Scene 2: Plan your day in one place.
Scene 3: Try DayNest today.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and green with simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes; layout and font are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Silent; English text exactly as supplied.

must_haves: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt:
Create a SILENT 9-second 16:9 motion-design advertisement for fictional planning app DayNest. Precisely three scenes, each exactly 3 seconds, with hard cuts at 3.0s and 6.0s. Polished minimalist flat motion graphics, warm ivory background, navy typography, soft sage and peach accents. Use large, clean, perfectly legible centered sans-serif text. EXTREMELY IMPORTANT: The ONLY visible words in the entire video are the single exact sentence specified for its scene. No extra titles, logos, brand wordmarks, labels, numbers, letters, watermarks, interface text, background signage, tiny text, or subtitles. Do not display quotation marks or scene numbers. No audio whatsoever.
0.0–3.0 seconds: Show EXACTLY 'Less scrolling. More doing.' centered and fully readable for the whole scene. Beneath the sentence, abstract blank rounded cards slide gently into an orderly stack. Cards have no text or symbols resembling letters.
3.0–6.0 seconds: Hard cut. Replace previous sentence with EXACTLY 'Plan your day in one place.' centered and fully readable for the whole scene. Beneath it, blank rounded tiles assemble into a neat abstract planning grid. No calendar dates, letters, numbers or labels.
6.0–9.0 seconds: Hard cut. Replace previous sentence with EXACTLY 'Try DayNest today.' centered and fully readable through the final frame. Under the sentence, a simple sage rounded rectangle with NO text and a small abstract nest-like curved graphic. Gentle settling animation.
Preserve exact spelling, capitalization and punctuation. Only one specified sentence visible in each scene, never overlapping between scenes. Text remains still; animate only abstract graphics. No realistic screens, no people, no environmental backgrounds. Clean professional software launch advertising.
